message.content: {"13946_8353800604012": {"answer": "B", "reason": "The chest X-ray demonstrates bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy and multiple small nodules distributed along the peribronchovascular bundles, which are classic radiographic features of pulmonary sarcoidosis."}, "13946_8353800618066": {"answer": "C", "reason": "Bilateral symmetrical hilar lymphadenopathy combined with peribronchovascular nodules is highly specific for sarcoidosis and helps distinguish it from lymphoma or tuberculosis, which typically present with unilateral or asymmetric findings."}, "13946_8353800618966": {"answer": "B", "reason": "The imaging reveals bilateral lung nodules and hilar lymphadenopathy; the clustering of these nodules into larger masses (sarcoid galaxy sign) seen on CT confirms the diagnosis of sarcoidosis."}}
